run_quickbook_tests: run quickbook tests against a .qbk file and compare output, dependencies, and locations to gold files
run_quickbook_with_flags: run quickbook on a .qbk file with extra flags like --no-self-linked-headers and compare output
load_dependencies: load a dependencies text file and return a set of unique dependency paths
load_locations: load a locations text file and return a dict of dependencies and globs with found status
create_temp_file: create a temporary file with a given extension and return its path
